jobs.title: Interviewing
jobs.description: Interview Process | DoiT Careers Skip to main content Careers Home Teams Interviewing Doer Stories About Us For Doers All roles 32 → Interview process Six steps, roughly three weeks start to finish. Every interview is a video call — no surprise on-sites, no all-day marathons. We tell you what to expect at each stage, and we give feedback whether you get the offer or not. Straight from our recruiters M Martin Conway TA Partner Do Be curious. Interviews are as much for you as for the company — asking thoughtful questions shows genuine interest. Treat the process like a customer journey. Concise follow-up emails go a long way in showing your enthusiasm. Stay structured. Your answers should have a start, middle, and end — emphasise the how, not just the why. Avoid Forgetting which role you applied for. If you're exploring multiple opportunities, keep track so you show up prepared. Lengthy CV paragraphs. Lead with the most relevant info, bullet your achievements, and mirror keywords from the job description. Brushing off failure stories. Failure is fine as long as you can show you analysed it and learned from it. L Lital Ben Porat Director of Global TA Do Practise active listening — reusing language from the question in your response shows the interviewer you're engaged. When interviewing with a cross-cultural team, be ready for different norms. Stay open and adaptable. Create a personable connection that makes you memorable. A genuine smile often helps, when appropriate. Avoid Brushing off your weaknesses. Instead, show confidence in your ability to close the gaps. Pulling all your rabbits out of a hat at once. Pick the most relevant examples and save the rest for later rounds. Exhausting the interviewer with overly long answers. Keep it simple, with clear messaging. O Oscar Rodriguez Talent Specialist Do Stay curious — ask thoughtful questions that show you've done your homework on the role and team. Share specific scenarios where you collaborated effectively and highlight what you personally brought to the table. Be a good listener. Keep your answers concise, clear, and to the point — quality over quantity. Avoid Coming unprepared. Research the company, understand the role, and have thoughtful questions ready to go. Faking it till you make it. It's perfectly okay not to know something — be humble and genuine about it. Giving vague or generic answers. Be specific with your responses and back them up with real examples. B Brittney Robertson TA Partner Do Speak confidently about the things you know — own your expertise and let it come through naturally. Research the company and team beforehand. Always come prepared with questions that show real curiosity. Test your audio and video before the interview. Minimising technical hiccups lets you focus on the conversation. Avoid Ego — leave it at the door. Confidence is great, but arrogance will work against you. Pretending to know something you don't. Own what you don't know and showcase your appetite to learn and grow. Talking in circles. Be concise with your responses and make every word count. 1 Application review A recruiter reviews your application within five business days. No black-hole inboxes — you'll hear back either way. 2 Recruiter screen A 30-minute call to align on the role, your goals, and logistics like comp expectations and timeline. We'll share specifics about the team and product area. 3 Hiring manager interview A 60-minute conversation focused on how you handle ambiguity, make trade-offs, and operate in past roles. Behavioral, not trivia. 4 Team panel Meet 2–3 people you'd actually work with. For engineering roles: real-world technical scenarios, not LeetCode. For go-to-market roles: case-based discussions drawn from actual deals. 5 Leadership interview A senior leader digs into your experience and how you think about impact at scale. This is also your chance to ask hard questions about where the company is heading. 6 Decision The hiring team meets, makes a call, and you hear back within a week. Offers come with details. Rejections come with candid feedback you can actually use. Tips for your interview Prepare like you would for a peer conversation, not a test. Review the role description and think about the specific problems you've solved that are most relevant. Our technical interviews use production-like scenarios — brush up on system design and trade-off reasoning rather than algorithm puzzles. Test your video setup beforehand. Ask us tough questions — the best interviews are the ones where both sides are evaluating fit. Prepare like you would for a peer conversation, not a test. Our technical interviews use production-like scenarios — brush up on system design and trade-off reasoning rather than algorithm puzzles. Test your video setup beforehand. Ask us tough questions — the best interviews are the ones where both sides are evaluating fit. Frequently Asked Questions How soon will I hear back after an interview? You'll typically hear from your recruiter within 72 hours once the hiring team has had a chance to debrief. We don't leave people hanging. Can I apply to more than one role at a time? Technically yes, but we'd recommend focusing on the one role that best matches your background and interests. A targeted application is always stronger than a scattered one. What if I don't see a role that fits my skills? Sign up for job alerts to receive weekly or daily emails when new roles go live. You can also keep an eye out for our Evergreen roles — submit your CV there to join our talent community and be considered for future openings. Subscribe to Job Alerts Can I reapply if I'm not selected? Absolutely. You can reapply for the same role down the line, or — based on the feedback we share — explore other positions that are a closer match. jobs.description: Benefits & Perks | DoiT Careers Skip to main content Careers Home Teams Interviewing Doer Stories About Us For Doers All roles 32 → Be well and keep learning We hire people who have options. Our benefits are designed to make the decision easy — not with gimmicks, but with things that actually matter when you're building a career. See open roles Wellbeing Take care of yourself, and your people We provide a thoughtful set of benefits that allows Doers to be their best selves and do great work. Whether that means taking time to recharge, supporting your family, or prioritizing your mental health — we put people first. Unlimited Vacation No caps Take what you need. No accrual caps, no guilt. We track outcomes, not hours logged. Our leadership actively takes time off to normalize the culture — because burnout doesn't ship great products. Flexible Work 100% remote Work from wherever you do your best thinking. Set your own hours around your team's core overlap window. Early bird or night owl — we care about what you deliver, not when you deliver it. Parental Leave Generous paid parental leave for all new parents — birth, adoption, or foster. Because the first weeks matter, and no one should have to choose between a career and being present for their family. Health Insurance Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. We cover a significant portion of premiums for you and your dependents. Specifics vary by country, but the commitment to your health doesn't. Mental Health Support Access to therapy, counseling services, and wellness programs. Your mental health is not a perk — it's a priority. We provide the tools and the culture that makes using them normal. Growth Grow quickly, supported by scale We are voracious learners and teachers. From dedicated learning stipends to clear career paths, we invest in your development because your growth is our growth. Every Doer gets the resources to level up. Competitive Pay Top-tier pay We benchmark against top-tier tech companies and pay at or above market rate for your role and location. Transparent bands, annual reviews, and no lowball offers. Stock Options All employees Every employee gets equity in the company. As DoiT grows, you grow with it. We want everyone to have a real stake in the outcomes we're building together. Learning Stipend Annual budget A dedicated annual budget for courses, certifications, conferences, books, and personal development — technical or otherwise. Whether it's cloud certifications, leadership coaching, or a creative writing class, we fund it; you own the growth. Career Development Regular 1:1s with your manager focused on growth, not just status updates. Clear career ladders, internal mobility, and the support to transition between teams when the time is right. Culture A culture built on connection We're remote-first, but never remote-only. From peer recognition programs to in-person Surge sprints, we build real bonds across time zones. Great tools, great gear, and the freedom to do your best work from anywhere. Home Office Allowance Setup stipend A generous stipend to set up your ideal workspace — standing desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, whatever you need. Because great work requires great tools, wherever your office is. Top-Tier Equipment High-performance laptop, high-res displays, and any software you need — no approvals required. We invest in top-tier hardware so you can do your best work every day. Peer Recognition Colleagues nominate each other for impact through a company-wide program. Recognition comes with points you can spend on swag, gear, or anything you want — they work like cash. Real visibility, real rewards. Surge Sprints We're remote-first, but when decisions, design, or rapid iteration need a room — we Surge. These are self-organized, in-person sprints with clear goals, pre-work, and written outcomes. Small groups, real artifacts, full transparency. Sound like your kind of place? We're hiring across engineering, sales, product, and more. Find a role that fits. jobs.description: Life at DoiT | DoiT Careers Skip to main content Careers Home Teams Interviewing Doer Stories About Us For Doers All roles 32 → We seek relentless, curious builders DoiT is for people who care about cloud infrastructure and the businesses that depend on it. We help the world's most ambitious organizations run smarter on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure — from the engineers building on it to the finance leaders optimizing what they spend. See open roles Culture Discover DoiT Everything we do is centered on making it easier for engineering teams to build, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure at scale. We believe deeply in the craft of cloud engineering, and we look for people who share that belief. That goes beyond engineering. Our teams work directly with customers — CFOs, platform engineers, FinOps practitioners — to turn cloud complexity into measurable business outcomes. If you care about driving real impact across an organization, not just shipping code, you'll find that here. DoiT's platform serves thousands of companies across 70+ countries, and our team of 700 works fully remotely from 40+ nations. Engineers ship to production on their first week. The CEO still answers Glassdoor reviews and pushes code himself. No one here uses the phrase "circle back." And since our ambitions far outstrip our current product portfolio, we also look for people who are curious, energetic, and unusually effective. Our values Six beliefs that shape how we work, hire, and build. Act As One Team We each bring deep expertise and strong ownership, but the best work here happens together. Wow the Customer We take genuine pride in going beyond expectations — whether it's resolving a critical issue at 2 AM or rethinking an entire cloud strategy. See It Through We care about the details and the results in equal measure. Half-done work doesn't leave our hands. Be Entrepreneurial We think in terms of impact, not tickets. Everyone is empowered to spot high-leverage opportunities and move on them. Pursue Knowledge Self-motivated learners who chase new challenges, skills, and ideas. Growth is funded and expected, not aspirational. Have Fun Joke, laugh, hang out — enjoy the ride. The best teams are the ones that genuinely like working together. “ DoiT feels like a place where curiosity, creativity, and initiative aren't just welcomed, but expected. Managers trust you, give you space, and treat you like a capable adult. ” Current Employee , Engineering How we work We default to open. Communication and documentation are rooted in inclusivity, autonomy, and trust. Teams are highly aligned and loosely coupled — empowered to move fast without waiting for permission. We trust everyone to work from anywhere and deliver. No surveillance, no mandatory office hours. This flexibility also lets us hire from the deepest, most diverse talent pool possible. Explore our teams AI-First company AI is how we work, not what replaces us AI isn't a buzzword here — it's how we work, every day. Every employee gets access to the best AI tooling available, and we use it to move faster, think bigger, and focus on work that requires a human brain. AI-powered development Unlimited Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex licenses for every engineer. AI-assisted coding isn't optional — it's expected. AI in our products ML models and LLMs power our platform — optimizing cloud spend, detecting anomalies, and generating recommendations at scale. AI-driven customer outcomes Our platform doesn't just surface insights — it drives action. Teams use Cloud Intelligence, PerfectScale, and SELECT to help customers reduce waste, improve reliability, and mature their FinOps practices. Internal AI tools Our Business Systems team builds AI-powered automation that helps every department work smarter with better data. Culture of experimentation Internal hackathons, dedicated AI Slack channels, and the freedom to tinker. The best ideas often come from a Friday afternoon experiment. Be well We support our team with benefits that actually matter — unlimited vacation, real equity, competitive pay, comprehensive health coverage, and generous parental leave. We provide a home-office stipend and a learning budget so you can keep honing your craft. Rigorous onboarding and product training get you shipping in your first week. Benefits & support “ What surprised me most is how deeply we get embedded in our customers' cloud strategy. You're not just advising — you're helping shape how organizations think about cloud spend and operations at scale. ” Current Employee , Customer Experience Diversity & Inclusion Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success. A look at the culture of trust, flexibility, opportunity, and support that defines DoiT — and the women across our global team who reflect it in their day-to-day experience. Women of DoiT Help us build the future of cloud intelligence. See open roles Explore teams Learn about engineering, sales, product, and more. jobs.title: Remote Work
jobs.description: Remote Work at DoiT | DoiT Careers Skip to main content Careers Home Teams Interviewing Doer Stories About Us For Doers All roles 32 → #WorkFromAnywhere Work from anywhere. Literally. No headquarters. No "return to office" plan. No asterisks. DoiT has been fully remote since before it was trendy — and we're not going back. 700+ people across 40+ countries, working asynchronously by default. See open roles Our philosophy Remote isn't a perk. It's how we're built. Remote at DoiT isn't a perk — it's how we're built. Since our first hire, we've designed every process, tool, and cultural norm around the idea that great work doesn't require a shared zip code. Our teams span six continents and dozens of time zones, yet ship product with the velocity of a co-located startup. We don't do "remote-friendly." We do remote-first. Meetings are the exception, not the default. Decisions happen in documents and threads. If it can be a five-minute Loom instead of a thirty-minute call, it should be. How we work Built for deep work, not busywork 1 Async by default Meetings are the exception, not the rule. Decisions happen in documents and threads. We write things down so everyone — regardless of time zone — can contribute on their own schedule. 2 Trust over surveillance No time trackers. No mouse jigglers. We measure output, not hours online. If the work ships and customers are happy, the how and when are up to you. 3 Your home, your HQ Every employee gets a home office stipend to set up a workspace that works for them. Your setup, your rules — we just make sure you have the budget to do it right. 4 Flexibility, not just a policy Unlimited PTO, including dedicated mental health days and volunteering days. No approval theater — your manager trusts you to manage your own calendar. Radical transparency Loosely coupled, highly aligned We're loosely coupled but highly aligned. Every team operates with autonomy, but nobody works in a vacuum. Information flows freely — and that's by design. Company all-hands Regular all-company meetings where leadership shares strategy, results, and what's ahead — no sugarcoating. Department & team all-hands Every department and team runs its own all-hands, and they're open to anyone in the company. Curious about what another team is building? Just show up. Monthly ask-me-anything Every month, the entire executive team — including our CEO — sits down for a live AMA. Any question, any topic, no filter. Everything documented Every session is recorded and documented in our wiki. Missed a meeting? Joined last week? You'll always have full context — nothing gets lost. Connection Remote, not distant Remote doesn't mean isolated. We fly teams together for off-sites, hackathons, and celebrations throughout the year. When we do meet in person, it's intentional — focused on building relationships, not sitting in conference rooms. Recognized as a best place to work 100% Remote-First, Market-Agnostic — awarded by BuiltIn for 2025. Ready to work from anywhere? Find a role that fits your skills — and your time zone. Home Intelligent Technologies Cabling Cloud Data Centres Enterprise Security Green Mobile Software Industry Verticals Aviation Banking & Finance Education Energy Government Healthcare Manufacturing Telecom Trade & Logistics Regions Canada East Coast West Coast Analysis Blogs Case Studies Insights Research Videos Podcasts Events Whitepapers Huawei Hub Contact Us DoiT expands AWS partnership to boost enterprise generative AI adoption Bill Tanner | 27 August, 2025 DoiT has announced an expansion to its strategic collaboration agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) focused on advancing DoiT’s GenAI capabilities for AWS customers at any stage of their AI journey. This announcement follows a successful 2025 in which DoiT launched a wave of GenAI accelerators to drive customer success. These accelerators contributed to significant growth across DoiT’s customers, with Amazon Bedrock consumption increasing 1,254% and Amazon Q use more than doubling. The collaboration between DoiT and AWS means customers are able to move from use case ideation to proof of concept to production within an average of six weeks. In 2023, DoiT signed a five-year SCA with AWS to drive US$5 billion in business and further deliver cloud consumption for born-in-the-cloud digital native organisations to large enterprises. Since then, DoiT has added six AWS competencies, including the GenAI competency and five AWS service delivery designations. DoiT has also achieved more than 500 AWS certifications across its cloud architects and is a member of six partner programmes. The company was recently selected as a finalist in the AWS Nova Partner Demo competition for its Marketing Campaign Generator and Analyzer. “As generative AI reshapes the future of business, our expanded collaboration with AWS ensures that customers have access to the most advanced, scalable and cost-efficient solutions available,” said Vadim Solovey, CEO of DoiT. “Together, we’re accelerating innovation, making GenAI truly enterprise-ready, all backed by deep expertise, trusted infrastructure and a relentless focus on delivering business value.” Through the DoiT Cloud Intelligence platform, AWS customers can access a wide range of features that provide valuable insights and actions to optimize their GenAI investments, aligning workloads with business intent to manage risks and enable action at scale. jobs.title: Account Executive - Attribute™, NORDICS
jobs.description: Location This is a fully remote opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Sweden. The role will be accountable for new business sales activities in Nordic Territories. Something new is launching at DoiT. We're not saying everything yet. Here's what we can say: it solves one of the hardest unsolved problems in FinOps , the product is real, we established product-market-fit, the early customer conversations are unusually good, and we're building the sales team to take it to market across North America and EMEA. If you've ever wanted to be an employee number something-small on a product that actually moves the category, this is that role. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. 700 people, 40+ countries, zero offices. The best idea wins regardless of timezone. The Opportunity This is a sales role on a brand-new FinOps product line inside DoiT. The category is one most FinOps teams know they have a problem in, and most vendors can't actually solve. We can. You'll be among the first people carrying it. You'll help shape the pitch, not inherit one. You'll write the playbook with us, take it into customer conversations the same week, and feed everything back into product, marketing, and pricing. The accounts you land in the first six months become the references that define the category. You'll own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments. That means finding the right prospects, running compelling solution pitches, navigating technical objections alongside our engineers, and closing complex partnerships end to end. You'll have the rest of the DoiT Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you. 4,500 customers. AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure partnerships. Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is new, and the market doesn't know it exists yet. That's the opportunity. Expect to travel 10 to 15 percent of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscaler teams, and show up at industry events that matter. Responsibilities Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets Help define the EMEA go-to-market motion for a new product line. ICP, messaging, objection handling, pricing posture, all of it Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week. In an early stage team, that loop is the job Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach. Not just working what's handed to you Qualifications Demonstrated experience running full sales cycles in the technology industry, ideally in new business roles selling SaaS, PaaS, or IaaS products A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work 2+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in B2B SaaS with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas Comfort selling something new. You've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way Technical curiosity. You understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud or Azure products and architecture Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud. jobs.title: Account Executive - Attribute™, North America
jobs.description: Location This is a fully remote opportunity based in US East or US West, with travel as needed. ****Something new just launched at DoiT — and now we can talk about it.**** Meet Attribute™ : AI tokenomics without tags, SDKs, or code changes. A lightweight eBPF sensor installs in 15 minutes and starts producing per-customer, per-feature, and per-agent token economics the same day. No instrumentation. No tagging policy. No engineering lift. The problem it solves is real and measurable. In DoiT's survey of 500 finance and technology leaders , only 15% said they could calculate AI ROI without significant bottlenecks — and 79% experienced AI-related cost overruns in the past 12 months. AI spend is tripling. Visibility isn't keeping up. Attribute™ fixes that, at the kernel level, with nothing to instrument. We've established product-market fit. The early customer conversations are unusually good. Now we're building the founding sales team to take it to market across North America and EMEA. If you've ever wanted to be employee number something-small on a product that actually moves the category, this is that role. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state — from planning to production. Delivering Cloud Intelligence™, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. 700 people, 40+ countries, zero offices. The best idea wins regardless of timezone. The Opportunity This is a seller role on Attribute™ - a brand-new product line inside DoiT that solves one of the hardest unsolved problems in FinOps: knowing exactly where AI money is actually being spent. Until now, attributing AI spend meant instrumenting it. Engineering teams wrapped every model call in an SDK, threaded metadata through every request, or enforced tagging standards that shared GPUs and single-account model APIs were defeated by design. Attribute™ takes the opposite approach: it measures what actually runs. The sensor observes real consumption at the OS kernel and maps every unit of GPU, CPU, API call, memory, network, and I/O back to the process, container, pod, and request responsible — including outbound calls to Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and AWS Bedrock. Cached, reasoning, input, and output tokens are split automatically. The result is token economics that holds up to audit, with zero engineering effort to produce or maintain. You'll help shape the pitch, not inherit one. You'll write the playbook with us, take it into customer conversations the same week, and feed everything back into product, marketing, and pricing. The accounts you land in the first six months become the references that define the category. You'll own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments — finding the right prospects, running compelling solution pitches, navigating technical objections alongside our engineers, and closing complex partnerships end to end. You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity. Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscaler teams, and show up at industry events that matter. Responsibilities Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets Help define the North America go-to-market motion for Attribute by DoiT - ICP, messaging, objection handling, pricing posture, all of it Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across North America Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience Feed real customer signal back to prod

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Cloud & SaaS Integrations
jobs.description: Location Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view. You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does. You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place. Responsibilities Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first. Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar. Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention. Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves. API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform. Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec. Qualifications 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production Strong TypeScript , including modern frontend work - React preferred Hands-on experience with Go , or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs , and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface Working proficiency in SQL Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure) A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps Excellent

jobs.title: Head of Deals Desk & Pricing Strategy
jobs.description: Location At DoiT, calling us ‘remote friendly’ would be an understatement. That said, our Head of Deals Desk & Pricing Strategy will ideally be located on the East Coast of the United States, operating in the Eastern time zone. It’s our experience that this allows for maximum collaboration with geographically diverse Sales and Finance teams located across the Americas, EMEA, Israel, and APJ. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure you’re operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help you solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity We’re excited to continue building out a team of Operations rock stars to help drive the next wave of growth here at DoiT. The Head of Deals Desk & Pricing Strategy will develop and lead a team of thought partners, hell bent on enabling Sales teams and accelerating revenue growth. They will do this in primarily two ways: 1) Better deals and 2) More deals. Better deals means developing and implementing clear pricing strategies and partner incentive programs that maximize bookings and net revenue. It’s helping coach sellers through relevant DoiT policies and finding creative paths to win commercially. More deals means driving clear processes, policies, and approval guidelines that help remove the sand in the gears for sellers: improving contract velocity, streamlining administrative overhead, and giving the Sales team time back to do what they do best…sell. Reporting directly to the VP, GTM Strategy, this role requires a unique balance of strategic vision and hands-on leadership to drive scalability and efficiency as our company grows. The ideal candidate is someone who has seen the Deals Desk growth story play out before - having a track record of successfully building strategic pricing functions that enable productive sales teams and drive profitable growth. Responsibilities You will have the opportunity to put your fingerprints on the organization by leading the development of our global Deals Desk team; driving the strategy behind, and owning every aspect of, the end-to-end deal desk process You will form a close partnership with Legal, acting as strategic advisors to the Sales and Finance teams - serving as a subject matter expert and thought leader on matters of complex/creative deal structuring, leveraging partner pricing strategies, contract negotiations, deal reviews, and quote/contract management Be the first line of defense in the deal review process - coaching reps on deal commercial structuring and best practices that help increase awareness and accelerate deal velocity Lead the development and documentation of DoiT’s best practices, booking policies, approval thresholds, and models that enable repeatable processes and scale Centralize the execution and administration of various partner incentive programs to drive better deals for DoiT and our customers alike Establish, track, and report on relevant KPIs and SLAs around the proper functioning of a high-level Deals Desk team Build and maintain a Deals Desk content library that gives Sales teams self-serve access to best practices on deal mechanics, order processing, structure and execution. Leverage technology to streamline workflows, increase productivity, and support growth of our Deals Desk, Sales, Finance, and Legal teams. Partner with the Revenue Accounting team to review and alleviate revenue/booking recognition concerns for non-standard deal structures Hire, coach, and develop a global team of high performing deal experts Qualifications 8+ years combined experience leading and scaling high-performing Deals Desk, Finance, or Sales Ops teams at a high growth, global tech company Proven track record of building Deals Desk or Strategic Pricing functions, enable Sales teams to drive measurable increases in deal velocity and revenue growth A history of creative solutions to complex deal structures, including enterprise-level software agreements with a focus on resell and channel relationships An ability to think strategically and still roll up your sleeves, understanding the broader business and financial implications of different deal mechanics Demonstrated understanding of, and experience implementing, the tools and processes that enable Deals Desk, Sales, and Finance teams to streamline and accelerate the order to close process (QTC, CPQ, CLM, SFDC, etc) Highly emotionally intelligent (EQ) with an ability to confidently and clearly articulate your perspective, re: have a point of view An unwavering commitment to embrace change in the name of growth

jobs.title: NetSuite Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Location As a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in the United States (Eastern time zone), the UK, or Ireland. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity We are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing this work in-house, and we're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to own it. You will own our financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - as an engineer, not just an administrator. What sets this role apart is mindset. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice and instinctively looks for ways to automate it away. You will own the configuration and business logic of the financial systems, keeping each one doing what it does best, and partner with our internal engineering team on cross-system integration rather than wiring it together by hand. This is a high-ownership role serving Finance and Accounting directly. You will be their dedicated systems partner - someone who knows the platforms deeply, is invested in making them better, and treats reducing manual, error-prone work as the core of the job rather than something to do on the side. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how finance operations run as the company scales Responsibilities Own and administer our core financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - including configuration, business logic, and day-to-day system health. Identify manual, recurring, or error-prone finance operations (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting, procure-to-pay) and reduce or remove them through automation, choosing the simplest effective approach and partnering with engineering for heavier builds. Serve as the business-logic and data expert for the finance domain, partnering with engineering to define and maintain the rules and canonical definitions the systems rely on. Build cross-system integrations on a central, version-controlled, observable integration platform in partnership with engineering, rather than as one-off scripts buried inside individual tools. Act as the dedicated systems partner to Finance and Accounting: translate their needs into system capability, own those working relationships, and serve as the technical owner for financial-vendor onboarding, configuration, and administration. Use modern AI tooling to draft automations and accelerate routine system work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort. Qualifications 3-6 years administering a financial or ERP system, with hands-on NetSuite administration required, including: configuration, customization, user access, roles, permissions, and workflows; core modules such as General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management, Accounts, and subsidiary / multi-location structures; designing and implementing custom records, fields, and automations; building SuiteFlow automations in response to changing business needs; managing the NetSuite integration ecosystem. A working understanding of core finance and accounting processes: month-end close, reconciliation, accounts payable / procure-to-pay, and revenue. A strong drive to eliminate repetitive manual work, with a demonstrated track record of automating it (e.g. scripting, saved searches, workflow automation, or low-code/iPaaS tools). Sound judgment about where logic belongs - what should be system configuration, what should be a cross-system integration, and which system is the source of truth for a given piece of data. Strong collaboration and communication across both finance and engineering teams, with the ability to translate between them. Fluent English; knowledge of any other language is an advantage. Bonus Points: Comfort with at least one of SuiteScript, SQL, general scripting, or API-based automation, and the ability to read and reason about integrations even when engineering builds them. FloQast administration experience. Experience working against a central integration platform or in an event-driven environment. Comfort using AI coding and automation tools in day-to-day work. Depth in SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0), RESTlets, or NetSuite web services. Are you

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT Partner Platform
jobs.description: Location Our Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers. The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery. This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset. You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives , serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution. You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts. The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models. In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization. Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Delivery Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence. Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components. Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope. Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio. Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly. Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer. Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models. Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery. Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses. Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers. Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as: Multi-cloud billing aggregation. Partner margin and discount models. Customer invoicing and revenue operations. Usage and cost transparency. Marketplace and private offer workflows. Executive & Partner Validation Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions. Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses. Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect, Delivery (GenAI)
jobs.description: Location Our Senior Cloud Architect will be an integral part of our global Forward Deployment Engineering team. This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, Sweden, the Netherlands, and Israel and is available to Full-Time Employees. The job is also open to contractors in Eastern Europe or Portugal. About DoiT DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage public cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state—from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence , the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity As a Senior Cloud Architect, you will be part of our global Forward Deployed Engineering organization, working with rapidly growing companies in EMEA and around the world. This role sits within FDE Delivery and focuses on our install base, product adoption and customer health. You will: Lead the design and implementation of production-grade ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS (with awareness of multi-cloud environments). Act as a hands-on expert and trusted advisor for customers running AI/ML workloads at scale, from initial discovery through deployment and optimization. Translate complex business problems into cloud architectures that are secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and observable . Help evolve how DoiT uses AI/ML internally and with customers by turning one-off solutions into reusable patterns and “gravel roads” that influence the product roadmap. You will focus more on install base health, product adoption, proactive engagements, and account-team work . Responsibilities Core – Deep Cloud Expertise Be the trusted cloud engineer customers lean on for high‑impact technical optimization work across cost, reliability, security, and performance. Design and help implement solutions that: improve cost efficiency (rightsizing, reservations/commitments, storage optimization, etc.) increase reliability and resilience (HA/DR architectures, SLO/SLA‑aware designs) strengthen security posture (IAM, network segmentation, data protection, least‑privilege) reduce operational toil (automation, self‑service, guardrails, policy enforcement) Plan and deliver structured engagements such as Cloud Optimization Sessions , cost/efficiency/performance workshops, security posture or reliability reviews, and architecture deep dives / "well‑architected" style assessments. Respond to Expert Inquiry / support requests that require deep cloud engineering expertise, ensuring high‑quality, well‑explained resolutions. Bring domain depth in: ML / GenAI – deploying and operating ML/GenAI workloads (training and inference), GPU utilization, scaling, and cost control; MLOPS and integrating workloads with monitoring, logging, and FinOps; safe and efficient use of managed AI services. Builder – Product Feedback & Contribution Turn one‑off field work into reusable assets that improve both customer outcomes and the product itself. Convert one‑off customer solutions into Gravel Roads - reusable patterns such as playbooks, Terraform modules, CloudFlow templates, cloud diagrams, Composer Recipes -> DCI Insights, and internal /external documentation. jobs.title: Senior Commercial Counsel (CST/EST)
jobs.description: Location As Senior Commercial Counsel, you will be an integral part of our global legal team. This role is based remotely anywhere in the United States in EST or CST Time Zones. This role would cover activities in North America primarily, with support in EMEA and APAC as needed. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity DoiT is seeking a hands-on and enthusiastic legal professional to join the Legal Team of a high-growth, fast-paced, mission-driven company. This role will be essential in handling commercial negotiations with strategic partners, channel partners, customers and vendors, leading channel partner support activities (including MSP, VAR, distribution, SI, etc) as well as in advising DoiT on a variety of complex legal matters, including legal guidance on go-to-market and strategic initiatives. Your proactive and solution-oriented approach will be valued as you effectively manage legal risks and foster strong relationships with internal stakeholders. Reporting directly to the General Counsel, you will have a unique opportunity to help scale the business while substantively contributing to the success of a growing and evolving technology-focused business. R esponsibilities Draft and negotiate commercial agreements, identifying key aspects to align with business goals, and being proactive and pragmatic in addressing potential issues. Such agreements include strategic transactions and partner agreements, license agreements, SaaS and professional service agreements, data processing agreements, and vendor contracts. Provide and lead legal support for channel partner activities. Assist in handling other legal matters, which may include product launch support, collections, human resources and/or litigation matters. Handling day-to-day legal inquiries, in cooperation with other legal team members and the business units/departments; Dealing with ad hoc legal matters as needed – corporate entity support, risk assessments, compliance documentation, data privacy assessments and reviews. Qualifications Juris Doctorate required. 8+ years substantive experience in providing legal advice in an international corporate environment. Highly skilled and previous experience in supporting a sales team in a technology company, SaaS and channel partner program experience required. Experience on product and offering launches preferred. Commercial mindset: team player with the ability to work with cross-functional departments and having a strong understanding of Sales their needs while managing risk appropriately. Detail oriented with an ability to organize and work across multiple projects and multiple time zones. Must be self-driven, resourceful, results and deadline oriented, and have a high multi-task proficiency. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing business environment. English + knowledge of any other language is an advantage. Are you a Do’er? Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values . Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button. Unlimited PTO Flexible Working Options Health Insurance Parental Leave Employee Stock Option

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility
jobs.description: Location The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity AI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them. We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see. You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't. Responsibilities Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec. Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision. Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar. Full-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious - clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on. API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform. Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn. Qualifications 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end-to-end in production Strong Go for backend services - APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery Product-oriented thinking - you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution Excellent communication skills in English, both writte

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity AI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them. We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see. You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't. Responsibilities Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec. Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision. Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar. Full-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious - clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on. API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform. Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery Product-oriented thinking - you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution Excellent communication skills in English, both writte

We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity AI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them. We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see. You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't. Responsibilities Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec. Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision. Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Mentor peers and share what you learn. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Location Our Senior Platform Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. The Opportunity As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and evolving the foundational software and services that empower our product and development teams. This is an Individual Contributor role requiring strong coding skills alongside hands-on work with GCP & AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. You will be a key contributor to the design, implementation, and automation of our platform as a product, ensuring its scalability, reliability, and security. Responsibilities Function as an individual contributor within the team: actively collaborating with peers through thorough code reviews, providing constructive support and mentorship, and contributing to a unified technical direction for the platform. This role also requires collaboration with individuals in feature teams, providing them with support and working with them to facilitate the adoption of developed platform features. Architect, Design, and Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC): You will treat our infrastructure as a sophisticated software system, responsible for its comprehensive lifecycle management using Terraform. This involves applying best practices from software engineering, such as designing reusable code modules, implementing robust unit and integration testing strategies, and ensuring that our infrastructure is consistently provisioned and managed in a predictable and repeatable manner. Deploy, Manage, and Optimize Kubernetes Clusters on GCP (GKE) and AWS (EKS): You will take ownership of the deployment, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of our Kubernetes clusters on GCP Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) kit. This includes managing node groups, configuring network policies, implementing service meshes, handling cluster upgrades, and ensuring high availability and fault tolerance. You will also be responsible for monitoring cluster health, performance, and resource utilization, and proactively addressing any issues that arise. Develop and Refine Internal Software Delivery Systems (CI/CD: You will design, implement, and maintain robust Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) software specifically tailored for our platform components. This involves integrating tools like Argo CD or Atlantis, applying advanced programming concepts to automate build and release processes, and ensuring seamless deployment of platform updates. You will also focus on optimizing pipeline performance and reducing deployment times. Diagnose, Troubleshoot, and Resolve Platform-Related Issues: You will be the primary point of contact for diagnosing and resolving platform-related issues, including performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, and security vulnerabilities. This involves utilizing advanced troubleshooting techniques, analyzing logs and metrics, and collaborating with development teams to identify and resolve root causes. You will also contribute to creating comprehensive incident response plans and post-mortem analyses. Drive Automation Initiatives to Streamline Operational Tasks and Enhance System Reliability: You will champion automation initiatives to eliminate manual operational tasks, reduce human error, and improve overall system reliability. This involves developing scripts, tools, and workflows to automate tasks such as infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and monitoring. You will also proactively identify opportunities for automation and drive continuous improvement in our operational processes. Act as a Strategic Partner to Development Teams, Understanding and Addressing Their Infrastructure Needs: You will foster strong relationships with feature teams, treating them as your internal customers. You will actively engage with them to understand their infrastructure and developer experience requirements, provide expert guidance on platform capabilities, and ensure our platform effectively supports their development workflows. You will also translate developer needs into actionable platform product features and roadmaps. Drive Development of Internal Platform Product and Services: You will actively participate in the full software development lifecycle (design, code, test, and deploy) of internal tools and APIs.
